description: Face fix, step 2 of 2 — PAID: redraw the faces of the stretches that lab_face_fix found, with Kling, and put them back into the clip. Call with get_cost first: the answer lists every stretch with its seconds and price. Charged per stretch; a stretch whose redraw does not pass the check (identity not better, too much flicker) is refunded on its own and stays as the original. A NEW video row comes back; the original stays. The backend refuses with a named reason (face_fix_analyse_nicht_fertig, face_fix_nichts_zu_tun, face_fix_bereits_freigegeben, face_fix_analyse_veraltet, face_fix_analyse_abgelaufen) before anything is charged. An analysis can be approved once and only within 24 hours (the face crops are deleted after that): for another try, run lab_face_fix again (free). Costs credits when called without get_cost.

get_cost.description: Preflight: return the stretches and the price per stretch WITHOUT starting anything and without spending. Do this first and let the human confirm.

job_id.description: Job id of the finished lab_face_fix analysis — positive integer as string.

nur_eigene_daten.description: Only for a model that sends inputs to China or a US recipient without a documented basis, when the step carries images, clips, voices or faces. Means: this material shows or contains no real person other than the human using this account. Set it ONLY after the human has said exactly that for THIS step; never assume it, never reuse it for the next step. Not needed when the human has declared this material in the FilmLab app: the backend reads that declaration, also for material derived from it; only the app can store one. An LK reference, a licensed likeness or another person's agreement does not replace it. Without it the backend refuses with drittland_dritte_gesperrt before any charge; then use a non-gated model or text only.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string.
